name: Easier Waypoints
summary: See the selected road lane and its direction before placing a waypoint.
description:
One road. One direction. No guesswork.

Easier Waypoints is an experimental visual aid for road waypoint placement. It highlights the candidate lane and draws travel arrows before placement. A two-way edge receives arrows in both directions. The native Line Manager keeps control of placement, movement and removal.

HOW TO TRY
Select a road line and the stretch you want to edit in the Line Manager. Use the game's displayed Add Waypoint action and hover over each side of a road. Compare the lane highlight and arrows before clicking. Existing waypoint movement and removal use the game's usual controls.

LIMITS
This prototype has not yet been verified in-game. It does not predict the full route or decide whether a lane is reachable. Some junctions and unsupported lane data use the original game feedback. Other mods replacing the same placement tooltips or stop panel may conflict.

CHANGES

v0.1.0 — Experimental direction preview
Candidate road lane highlight, directional chevrons, clearer placement guidance and selected-segment context. No simulation commands or custom save data.
